items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Well, it was Freddy Kepard, Big Eye Louie, P. Ron, Willie Santiago, and a bass player called Tiet Rochon... there was Tiet Rochon, Freddie Capard, Big Eye Louie, Eddie Vinson... when they organized the Olympia band

ctx.x: Who was in the Olympic, not everybody, but just one or two to identify?
Well, it was Freddy Kepard, Big Eye Louie, P. Ron, Willie Santiago, and a bass player called Tiet Rochon, he's dead now.
And the Imperial was Manuel Perez.
